Membership

Join OKNAHRA

Membership runs one year from the date payment is received. Choose the class that matches your role — see the full eligibility rules in our Bylaws.

Associate Membership

$100 / year

For individuals actively employed in HR or another role with a Native American tribe or tribal enterprise.

  • Full voting rights at the annual Membership Meeting
  • Eligible to hold elected office on the Board
  • Reduced pricing on OKNAHRA events and the biannual Summit
  • Newsletter, job board, and networking directory access
Join Now

Native Non-Profit Associate

$100 / year

For employees or elected officials of Native non-profit organizations.

  • Non-voting membership
  • Reduced pricing on OKNAHRA events and the biannual Summit
  • Newsletter, job board, and networking directory access
Join Now

Corporate Membership

Contact us

For vendors, consultants, and suppliers who serve tribal enterprises but aren't employed by one.

  • Non-voting membership
  • Visibility with HR decision-makers across Oklahoma tribal enterprises
  • Newsletter and event access
Contact Us

Student Membership

$100 / year

For students enrolled in post-secondary education in HR or a related field.

  • Non-voting membership
  • Reduced pricing on OKNAHRA events and the biannual Summit
  • Newsletter, job board, and networking directory access
Join Now

"Join Now" buttons are wired for Stripe Payment Links. Create one Payment Link per paid tier in the Stripe Dashboard (Payment Links → New), then paste each URL into pages/membership.py in place of the matching PASTE_STRIPE_PAYMENT_LINK_… placeholder and rebuild. No card data ever touches this site — Stripe hosts the checkout page.

How dues are used

Your membership funds the mission

Programming

The biannual Summit, training, and networking events for Oklahoma tribal HR professionals.

Advocacy

Monitoring and responding to legislation affecting employment across Indian Country.

Certification

Supporting tribal-specific HR certification pathways and continuing education.

OKNAHRA

The Oklahoma Native American Human Resources Association supports HR professionals serving Oklahoma's tribal nations and tribal enterprises.
